title: Maximum Erasure Value
goal: Find the greatest sum of a contiguous subarray containing no repeated values.
strategy: Keep a set and running sum for the current unique window. On a repeated incoming value, remove left entries through its old occurrence; positive values make the longest valid suffix best.
